display_name: 画板操作（节点 / 连线 / 媒体池 / 任务）
description: Drive the A3 canvas workbench through conversation — create nodes, write configs, wire ports, generate media, run jobs. Use when the user wants to build or edit a workflow board by talking to it. Covers lock discipline, the port-matching iron rule, quote-first submissions, and failure self-correction.

changelog.changes: QA #15 hardening: input_port on a non-material source is a loud structured error (never silently dropped to a plain depends_on edge); the material pool pointer is read leniently (pool_entry_id or the entry_id alias) and normalized to the canonical pool_entry_id inside the same locked write, with the normalization reported on the action row; SKILL.md documents the never-dropped input_port rule and the canonical field name

first official canvas skill (A3 S3): the ten FR-3 tools plus two board reads; lock discipline with board-busy reporting; port-matching iron rule (query_schema before connect, minimax-h3 first_frame/reference_image exclusivity as the canonical case); quote-first paid submissions; failure self-correction methodology
